why: Paragraph 28 has the stranger name the two horses in the Wessex Cup, 'Silver Blaze and Bayard.'

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — get information to bet on
why: The stranger asks the lad for 'the straight tip' on Bayard's weights and says 'you won't be a loser,' which points to betting on inside information. The question is a plain one the text gives reason to ask.
